import bpy, os
from mathutils import Vector
from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
expected=os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'))
if os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(bpy.data.filepath))!=expected: raise RuntimeError('arquivo errado')
print('FILE='+bpy.data.filepath)
print('--- VISIBLE COLLECTIONS ELEVATOR/TERRAIN ---')
for c in bpy.data.collections:
    n=c.name.lower()
    if any(k in n for k in ('lacerda','elevador','terreno','terrain','chatgpt','realv2','calibracao')):
        # effective enough for current root hierarchy: local flags
        if not c.hide_viewport and not c.hide_render:
            print(f'VISIBLE_COLL={c.name}|objects={len(c.objects)}')
print('--- VISIBLE OBJECTS LEGACY-LIKE ---')
keep_prefix=('V4 |','WORLD | TERRENO MASTER')
for o in bpy.data.objects:
    n=o.name.lower()
    if any(k in n for k in ('lacerda','elevador','torre','passadico','entrada superior','bridge_test','chatgpt_teste')) and not o.hide_viewport and not o.hide_get():
        cols=[c.name for c in o.users_collection]
        print(f'VISIBLE_OBJ={o.name}|cols={cols}|Z={o.location.z:.2f}')
terrain=bpy.data.objects.get('WORLD | TERRENO MASTER | blockout')
coll=bpy.data.collections.get('01 WORLD | ELEVADOR LACERDA | blockout v4')
if not terrain or not coll: raise RuntimeError('master terrain or v4 missing')
# Build BVH in world coordinates
verts=[terrain.matrix_world@v.co for v in terrain.data.vertices]
polys=[tuple(p.vertices) for p in terrain.data.polygons]
bvh=BVHTree.FromPolygons(verts,polys,all_triangles=False)
# sample lower bounds of hall / door / station floor-like objects
targets=[o for o in coll.objects if any(k in o.name.lower() for k in ('hall piso terreo','porta entrada','estacao laje piso 1','estacao parede frontal','estacao parede lateral')) and o.type=='MESH']
print('--- GROUND CONTACT ---')
for o in targets:
    pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(c) for c in o.bound_box]
    minz=min(p.z for p in pts)
    # sample 4 xy corners at lowest z + center
    xs=[p.x for p in pts]; ys=[p.y for p in pts]
    samples=[((min(xs)+max(xs))/2,(min(ys)+max(ys))/2),(min(xs),min(ys)),(min(xs),max(ys)),(max(xs),min(ys)),(max(xs),max(ys))]
    zs=[]
    for x,y in samples:
        hit=bvh.ray_cast(Vector((x,y,200.0)),Vector((0,0,-1)),400.0)
        if hit[0] is not None: zs.append(hit[0].z)
    if zs:
        print(f'CONTACT={o.name}|obj_bottom={minz:.3f}|terrain_z={min(zs):.3f}..{max(zs):.3f}|gap_centerish={minz-sum(zs)/len(zs):.3f}')
    else:
        print(f'CONTACT={o.name}|NO_TERRAIN_HIT|obj_bottom={minz:.3f}')
print('AUDIT_ACTIVE_ELEVATOR_GROUND_OK')
